d:
Chunav aayog ne suprim kort men halafnama dakhil kar kaha hai ki SIR se jure aadesh sarvasammati se jari kie gae the aur Form 6 men koee sanshodhan nahin kiya gaya.
Aayog ke mutabiq, bihar men SIR ke dauran istemal kie gae ghoshna-patr ko sirf alag se jora gaya tha. lekin indiyan eksapres ki riport men donon chunav aayukton ki ashamti ki bat kahi gaee thi.
Halafname men onlain ghoshna-patr ko lekar bhi safaee di gaee hai, lekin ise kisne manzuri di thi, yah spasht nahin hai. aise men saval hai ki chunav aayog ke javab se SIR aur Form 6 ko lekar uthe vivad par kya asar parega?
